message.content:
1: Ah, (interjection)  
2: that I should have forgotten the well-known saying, (noun clause)  
3: “with the crown of snow, there cometh wisdom!” (independent clause)  
4: That very hour the cruel law was abolished, (independent clause)  
5: and custom drifted into as far a past (independent clause)  
6: that only legends remain. (relative clause)
